rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: The party held its 17th regular convention on 22 and 23 February; in the leader election 副党首 福島みずほ was chosen unopposed as new party leader on the first day, returning to the post after seven years.
